caption: Karma runs the valet stand: park it, retrieve it, and never scratch the paint - the Dash loop in a lot.

req.note: 2003-2011 casual 2d, single-digit-to-double-digit-megabytes install. runs on anything, including hardware far below the target bar.

links.official_note: no official channel survives. playfirst folded into glu mobile in 2014, playfirst.com is dead, and the portals that carried the dash line closed with it. the pc build has nowhere legal left to be sold.
links.anyway_note: this is the un-buyable case: no store, no key server, no publisher counter. the archive route is the only route.

about: Parking Dash, released on 1 october 2008, stars Karma - Flo's friend from DinerTown - running a valet service, with development credited to kef sensei under playfirst. Cars queue at the stand, each driver with a patience meter, and every parked vehicle becomes a spatial puzzle to retrieve on demand.

The trade changes the verb set: driving lines replace walking routes, and the lot's layout matters as much as the queue order. It later reached steam in the playfirst batch of 2010 before that listing was pulled, which leaves the game without an official channel today.
The 2008 build is un-buyable - preserved through archives and hosted originals only.
